prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, paid media, branding, B2B, B2C, creative, etc.), your budget, timeline, industry, and whether you want a local partner or are OK with a remote/national shop.

A few quick questions and I can give a tailored recommendation and a short, ranked shortlist (with strengths, estimated costs, sample case studies and red flags):

1. What type(s) of marketing do you need? (e.g., SEO, content, paid ads, social, email, branding, web design, PR)
2. What are your primary goals? (e.g., leads, ecommerce sales, brand awareness, product launch)
3. Company size / monthly marketing budget (rough range is fine)
4. Industry or target audience (B2B/B2C, healthcare, tech, professional services, retail, etc.)
5. Preference for a local Maryland agency vs. national/remote?
6. Any timeline or upcoming milestones?

If you want a quick, non-tailored start, I can also list top Maryland agencies across common specialties and what they’re known for — tell me which you prefer.
